errors.text: The baseline properties are taken from the Nb-containing TiZrHfNbTa alloy rather than the specified HfMoTaTiZr alloy, producing an incorrect yield strength and fracture-strain comparison.

The proposed falsification specimen is deliberately homogeneous and therefore does not implement the hypothesized bimodal microstructure; its failure would not falsify the claimed heterostructure mechanism.
No cited evidence supports Mo grain-boundary segregation, enhanced edge-dislocation mobility in HfMoTaTiZr, or the asserted 30 at.% Mo phase-stability boundary.

The claimed approximately 10% density reduction from the stated substitution is neither calculated nor experimentally supported and is likely overstated for replacing only 10 at.% each of Hf and Ta with Mo.
